title: Juicy Aerated Jamaican Bramley Apples Tagine
description: Rich and nostalgic Jamaican dish featuring Bramley apples cooked in a tagine, perfect for a unique dinner experience. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe combines the sweetness of apples with the warmth of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped Bramley apples, Jamaican allspice, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the apples are tender.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the juicy aerated Jamaican Bramley apples tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
